summary: The 9,216-case replay executes the original decoder with stable input buffers and no helper interception. The flag-byte dimension includes 0, 1, 128, and 129, independently distinguishing low-bit gating from bit-7 gating: 1 and 129 take the set-bit path, while 0 and 128 take the clear-bit path. This matches LDRB zero-extension, LSLS #31, and BPL. The independent oracle’s ordered first/second output writes and statuses, preserved output pointers/registers, SP, PRIMASK, and stop state pass. This is bounded emulator evidence only; aliasing, volatile changes, flags/high-register contract, physical MMIO behavior and global ownership remain unresolved.
